description: Load the pwa-debug extension into an extension-capable Android browser (a Chromium fork such as Bare, org.barebrowser) over adb with no taps — the phone counterpart of the desktop --load-extension launch. Copies the bundled extension to the phone, marks the browser as the debug app so it reads /data/local/tmp/chrome-command-line, writes --load-extension there, maps the host's WebSocket link with adb reverse (Android has no native messaging, so the extension connects over it), restarts the browser and waits for the extension to connect. Returns the connection id; name? sets a persona name. remove: true unloads it. Stock Chrome on Android has no extension system — use pdl_android_attach for it. Args: serial?, browser?, name?, remove?, wait_ms?.

browser.description: Browser package, e.g. "org.barebrowser". Default: the only running extension-capable browser.

name.description: Persona name for the phone's extension connection, so tools take extension_id: '<name>'.

remove.description: Unload instead: remove the command-line file and the copied extension, clear the debug app, restart the browser.

serial.description: Device serial from pdl_android_devices; optional when one phone is connected.

wait_ms.description: How long to wait for the extension to connect after the restart (default 20000).

name: pdl_android_load_extension
